content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to configure the [product_name] operator device so that it automatically returns to the default screen after a set period? I've checked the forum but most results talk about [product_name] visualization software. My current setup includes an additional info screen—showing refill cycles and warnings for low pressure—that users can access using the arrow buttons. However, the screen stays active unless manually changed. I'm hoping to have it revert to the main screen after some time. Is this possible with [product_name], and if so, what are the relevant steps?
After a set time, all active message texts turn off, and then the start screen is shown automatically.

By start screen, do you mean the one displaying the clock? Currently, I have five message screens prioritized from 0 to 4; 0 is for additional info, and 1 is set as the main or default screen. I'll experiment further to see if this works when staying on the additional info screen. I tried configuring it using an F-key and a timer for returning to the default screen, but didn't achieve the result—so now I use the arrow buttons instead.
Are you referring to a self-made message text as the default screen? If so, activate it with a constant "on" signal and deactivate all other message texts once the defined time has passed.

Yes, by default screen, I mean a custom message screen set to be the main display. I'll double-check how it's running on the test machine and may try a few adjustments. At the moment, the default message text is set using an inverted enable input.
That approach works—the default screen remains active. Now, just set up all other message texts to be enabled after the specified time interval. Would you like an example?
Yes, an example would be very helpful. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are looking to configure a [product_name] operator panel to automatically return to a custom default/main screen after viewing additional or message screens for a set time. Current navigation requires manual interaction, and attempts to use function keys with a timer did not achieve the desired effect. Users need guidance and concrete examples to set up timed automatic reversion, and are uncertain whether it can be fully automated or remains a manual process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] operator panel to be configurable so that it automatically switches back to the main or default screen after a predetermined period without manual input.
